changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE notes ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_REVIEW', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT ck_notes_status CHECK (status IN ('PENDING_REVIEW', 'INSUFFICIENT', 'READY')), CONSTRAINT ck_notes_title CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0), CONSTRAINT ck_notes_content CHECK (length(trim(content)) > 0) ); CREATE TABLE verification_contexts ( note_id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES notes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, aspects JSONB NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT ck_context_aspects_array CHECK (jsonb_typeof(aspects) = 'array') ); CREATE TABLE repetitions ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, note_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES notes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, scheduled_on DATE NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ, CONSTRAINT ck_repetitions_status CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED')), CONSTRAINT ck_repetitions_completed CHECK (status <> 'COMPLETED' OR completed_at IS NOT NULL), CONSTRAINT uq_repetitions_id_note UNIQUE (id, note_id) ); CREATE INDEX ix_repetitions_due ON repetitions(status, scheduled_on); CREATE INDEX ix_repetitions_note ON repetitions(note_id); CREATE TABLE assessments ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, note_id UUID NOT NULL, repetition_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, transcription TEXT NOT NULL, score SMALLINT NOT NULL, explanation TEXT NOT NULL, evaluated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT ck_assessments_score CHECK (score BETWEEN 0 AND 100), CONSTRAINT fk_assessments_repetition_note FOREIGN KEY (repetition_id, note_id) REFERENCES repetitions(id, note_id) ); CREATE INDEX ix_assessments_note ON assessments(note_id);
